description: This file defines the VTSimpleTemplate class, which is responsible for rendering templates with placeholders that are replaced with dynamic data fetched from entities and metadata within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for parsing templates, matching pattern placeholders, retrieving metadata values, and handling references to related entities or modules.

classes.name: VTSimpleTemplate
classes.description: A class that provides methods to process and render templates with dynamic placeholders in the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the template with a template string.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template by replacing placeholders with actual data from the given entity cache and entity ID.

methods.name: matchHandler
methods.description: Handles pattern matching for placeholders in the template, replacing them with corresponding entity or metadata values.

methods.name: useValue
methods.description: Determines whether a data field value is non-empty and should be used.

methods.name: parseTemplate
methods.description: Performs the placeholder replacements within the template string.

methods.name: getMetaValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific metadata values based on the field name, including dates, URLs, and timezone info.
